answer: Work waits on the quill until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the mirror of the next round. The nebula of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, slashed on a failed audit. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
